title: Files
intro: Notes and documents your agents create on this desk. Every change is kept as a version, so you can look back and restore one.

empty.title: No files yet
empty.body: Files your agents create land here, with every version kept. You can also add a text file yourself.

new.contentPlaceholder: Type or paste the text of the file…

upload.hint: Text files only, up to {max}. Saved at the top level under the file's own name.
upload.tooLarge: {name} is larger than {max}, so it was not uploaded.
upload.binary: {name} is not a text file, so it was not uploaded.

viewer.missing: That file is not on this desk, or it was deleted.

restore.title: Restore version {version}?
restore.body: This saves the text of version {version} as a new latest version. Nothing is lost: the versions after it stay in the history.

delete.title: Delete {path}?
delete.body: The file leaves this list and agents can no longer read it. Deleting does not free storage space.

errors.generic: Something went wrong with the files. Try again.
errors.network: The files could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.notFound: That file is not on this desk.
errors.tooLarge: That text is larger than 2 MB.
errors.tooMany: This desk already holds the most files it can. Delete some first.
errors.denied: Files hold plain text only. That content is not valid text.
errors.badPath: That file path is not allowed.
errors.quota: This account has no storage space left. Every saved version counts.
errors.unavailable: The file store is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.badResponse: The files answered in a way this app does not understand.

pathErrors.empty: Give the file a path, like notes/plan.md.
pathErrors.absolute: Start the path at the top, with no leading /.
pathErrors.backslash: Use / between folders, not a backslash.
pathErrors.dots: Parts named . or .. are not allowed.
pathErrors.emptyPart: The path has an empty part (a doubled or trailing /).
pathErrors.tooLong: The path is longer than 240 characters.
pathErrors.tooDeep: The path has more than 8 parts (folders plus the file name).

deskSources.full: {max} files picked, the most that fit. Remove one to add another.
deskSources.tooLarge: These files and the pasted text are over the source limit, so only the first part is used.
